name: mordred-fated-luminary-same-level-levelup-needs-luminary-in-lineage
notes: Mordred, Fated Luminary (KqBosnU7pU): the same-level level-up exists only "for Mordred" with this lineage card. The champion is Aurelian Regent whose lineage does NOT contain Fated Luminary: choosing Fated Luminary (another level 3 champion) from the material deck is rejected by the engine, the champion stays Aurelian Regent and no card is drawn.

rulesClauses: Only a Mordred with Fated Luminary in the lineage can level up into a champion of the same base level.
